sources.title: segresnet-mlx · PyPI
sources.snippet: Segment brain tumors, renal structures and whole-body CT anatomy with MONAI SegResNet models in native MLX. ... Weights: 19 MB download for segresnet-brats, 76 MB for segresnet-renal-cect. Peak MLX memory: 4.9 GB for a 240×240×155 four-sequence brain MRI (segresnet-brats) and 4.0 GB for a 478×277×161 three-phase CT (segresnet-renal-cect). The MedMLX MCP server is the lowest-friction way to use this package. It installs this runtime, downloads its weights on first use, and lets an AI agent describe, check and run segresnet-brats and segresnet-renal-cect for you.
